data:
The course aims to give students a comprehensive understanding of portfolio
management principles, including constructing and evaluating portfolios.
Topics we cover include the market indices, efficiency frontier, the Markowitz portfolio,
capital asset pricing, model, arbitrage pricing theory, factor models, active and passive
investing, smart beta, beta core, bucket investment, simulation, optimization, Sharpe
ratio, Traynor ratio, Mutual funds etc.
Learning Objectives:
1. Understand risk and return
2. History of stock returns
3. Market efficiency
4. Risk return relationship
5. Construct and evaluate portfolios
